definitions.explanation: Describes quick, alert movement or thinking. Can refer to physical agility, mental quickness, or prompt response to situations.

⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{機敏|きびん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{反応|はんのう}した→反応する：20204_hannousuru⟧。
{機敏|きびん}な⟦{対応|たいおう}→対応：02510_taiou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦おかげ→おかげ：01362_okage⟧で、⟦{事故|じこ}→事故：00851_jiko⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{未然|みぜん}→未然：13084_mizen⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{防|ふせ}げた→防ぐ：02409_fusegu⟧。
examples.english: Thanks to the quick response, we were able to prevent the accident.

notes:
{機敏|きびん} stresses alert, ready reaction: seeing what is needed and acting at once, in body or in judgment. Adverb: {機敏|きびん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {機敏|きびん}な⟦{動|うご}き→動き：11926_ugoki⟧: nimble movement
- {機敏|きびん}な⟦{対応|たいおう}→対応：02510_taiou⟧: a prompt response
- {機敏|きびん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{反応|はんのう}する→反応する：20204_hannousuru⟧: to react quickly

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{俊敏|しゅんびん}→俊敏：09194_shunbin⟧: agile, swift — praises speed together with skill, often of athletes and animals
- ⟦{素早|すばや}い→素早い：17093_subayai⟧: quick — the everyday word
- ⟦{鈍重|どんじゅう}→鈍重：09192_donjuu⟧: sluggish, ponderous — the opposite
